h1.assistant: Need a hand choosing? Ask BYB

hero.title: BEFORE YOU BUY
hero.subtitle: Find the right thing, not just a product.
hero.description: Don't search stores. Tell BYB what you need.
hero.trust: BYB does not set or change merchant prices, and merchants cannot pay to improve their ranking. Shipping is shown only where the merchant provides it; confirm final costs with the merchant.

explore.subtitle: Shop smarter with expert help for every category.

commitments.title: Three things BYB will not do.

sell.title: We don't sell products.
sell.description: BYB is not a store. Purchases finish on the merchant's website, under the merchant's terms.

ranking.title: We don't sell ranking.
ranking.description: Merchants cannot pay to appear higher in search or shelves. Ranking follows catalog and comparison logic.

merchant.title: We don't hide the merchant.
merchant.description: Every offer names its source, and missing information stays visibly missing.

ledger.title: One product. Every listed offer.
ledger.subtitle: A live view from the available catalog, using merchant-provided prices and shipping where present.
ledger.caption: Offer ledger for {{product}}
ledger.note: Item prices are shown in their source currencies. Shipping is merchant-provided where available. Customs, duties and other import costs are not calculated.
ledger.emptyDescription: We couldn't load a product with listed offers right now. Search the catalog to keep comparing.

sources.title: Know where the offers come from.
sources.description: BYB's catalog is assembled from merchant and affiliate product feeds. Live merchant names appear on each offer; these are the source programs currently represented.
sources.ebay: Listings supplied through eBay's product feed, subject to eBay availability.
sources.aliexpress: Listings supplied through AliExpress, with prices in the merchant's source currency.
sources.fmtc: Affiliate merchant data supplied through FMTC. Individual merchants are named on each offer.
sources.note: Source marks identify feed provenance only. BYB does not imply a partnership, endorsement or sponsorship by these platforms; availability and terms remain with the merchant.

trust.title: A quieter way to compare before you buy.
trust.description: No countdown timers, no invented savings, no pressure to decide. BYB gives you the offer facts and a clear route to the merchant so you can make your own call.

trust.note: Customs, duties and full landed cost are not calculated. BYB does not change merchant prices or rank offers for payment. Confirm final price, shipping and returns with the merchant before purchase.
